scripts.build-simc: bash -lc 'set -e; REPO=https://github.com/simulationcraft/simc.git; REF=${SIMC_GIT_REF:-midnight}; FALLBACK_REF=master; BUILT_REF_FILE=simc/.build-ref; if [ -x simc/simc ] && [ -d simc/profiles ] && [ -f "$BUILT_REF_FILE" ]; then built_ref=$(cat "$BUILT_REF_FILE"); remote_ref=$(git ls-remote "$REPO" "$REF" | cut -f1); if [ -z "$remote_ref" ] && [ "$REF" != "$FALLBACK_REF" ]; then REF=$FALLBACK_REF; remote_ref=$(git ls-remote "$REPO" "$REF" | cut -f1); fi; if [ -n "$remote_ref" ] && [ "$built_ref" = "$remote_ref" ]; then echo "SimC already built for remote ref $REF ($remote_ref), skipping rebuild"; exit 0; fi; fi; set -ex; rm -rf temp_simc; if ! git clone --depth 1 --branch "$REF" "$REPO" temp_simc; then if [ "$REF" != "$FALLBACK_REF" ]; then REF=$FALLBACK_REF; git clone --depth 1 --branch "$REF" "$REPO" temp_simc; fi; fi; commit_hash=$(cd temp_simc && git rev-parse HEAD); cmake -B temp_simc/build temp_simc -DBUILD_GUI=OFF -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release; cmake --build temp_simc/build --target simc -- -j1; mkdir -p simc; cp temp_simc/build/simc simc/simc; cp -r temp_simc/profiles simc/profiles; echo "$commit_hash" > simc/.build-ref; rm -rf temp_simc; chmod +x simc/simc'
